buyMiningCard(uint8,uint8,uint256,uint25.details: Call path: user -> CardManager.buyMiningCard -> CardManager._previewMiningCardPayment -> PriceOracle -> -> InteractionPool.notifyUsdtInflow -> TradingRouter.checkAndSwitchMode(USDT) -> MiningCard.mint.

buyNodeCard(uint8,uint256).details: Call path: user -> CardManager.buyNodeCard -> CardManager._previewNodeCardPayment -> PriceOracle.quoteUsdtToMobSpot -> -> InteractionPool.notifyUsdtInflow -> TradingRouter.checkAndSwitchMode(USDT) -> CardManager._mintNode -> NodeCard.mint.

miningDailyRates(uint8).details: Call path: MiningSystem earnings/acceleration actions -> CardManager.miningDailyRates.

mintComposedMiningCard(address,uint8).details: Call path: user -> CardComposer.composeCard -> CardManager.mintComposedMiningCard -> MiningCard.mint.

operatorMintNode(address,uint8).details: Call path: operator -> CardManager.operatorMintNode -> CardManager._mintNode -> NodeCard.mint.

operatorMintNodeBatch(address,uint8,uint.details: Call path: operator -> CardManager.operatorMintNodeBatch -> CardManager._mintNode -> NodeCard.mint.

previewBuyNodeCard(uint8).details: Call path: DApp/CardManager.buyNodeCard -> CardManager.previewBuyNodeCard -> CardManager._previewNodeCardPayment -> PriceOracle.quoteUsdtToMob.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

setMiningComposer(address).details: Call path: owner -> CardManager.setMiningComposer; thenuser -> CardComposer.composeCard -> CardManager.mintComposedMiningCard.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

miningDailyRates(uint8).notice: Returns base, low-acceleration total, and high-acceleration total daily USDT earnings.

miningMintFee(uint8).notice: Returns the interaction-pool and foundation USDT mint-fee amounts for one mining card type.

miningSellLimit(uint8).notice: Returns the per-working-card USDT sell limit for one mining card type.

nodeSupplyStatus(uint8).notice: Returns one node type's minted supply, fixed cap, and remaining mintable quantity.

operatorMintMiningBatch(address,uint8,ui.notice: Lets the operator mint 1-100 mining cards of one type to one recipient for free.

operatorMintNodeBatch(address,uint8,uint.notice: Lets the operator mint 1-100 node cards of one type while enforcing that type's supply cap.

operatorMintOrganizationBatch(address,ui.notice: Lets the operator mint 1-100 organization cards of one type to one recipient for free.
